values.value: Copies your active DLRS rollups into BarnCRM Rollup Builder, compares each copy with the values DLRS wrote, and turns each copy on as you switch its DLRS rollup off. DLRS itself is never changed.

[{"key":"copy","label":"Copy Rollups Into Rollup Builder","kind":"tool","help":"On the Rollup Builder tab, under Other Rollup Tools, click Import From DLRS. Copy the rollups, compare them, and turn each copy on. Then come back here and click Mark Done.","tab":"Rollup_Builder","toolLabel":"Open Rollup Builder"}]

[{"key":"deactivate","text":"In DLRS (the Manage Lookup Rollup Summaries tab), clear Active on each rollup that now has a BarnCRM copy turned on."},{"key":"triggers","text":"In DLRS, remove the child triggers (Manage Child Trigger, Remove) of objects that no longer have an active DLRS rollup."},{"key":"jobs","text":"In Setup, Scheduled Jobs, delete the DLRS scheduled jobs of rollups now kept by BarnCRM."},{"key":"uninstall","text":"When nothing uses DLRS any more, uninstall it from Setup, Installed Packages."}]
